scripts.release:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run version:sync
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && npm run version:sync
scripts.release:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version && npm run version:sync
scripts.build:dist: npm run version:sync && node scripts/build-dist.mjs all
scripts.build:dist:chrome: npm run version:sync && node scripts/build-dist.mjs chrome
scripts.build:dist:firefox: npm run version:sync && node scripts/build-dist.mjs firefox
scripts.build:dist:checked: npm run version:check && npm run build:dist && npm run verify:dist
